correctness.rationale: An explicit primal x assigns weights 1, 1/2, and 1/4 by three-letter equality pattern. Exactly fifteen partitions of four positions yield ten distinct incidence profiles, each with primal covering sum at least 1. An explicit y on aaaa, aabb, abca and all-distinct four-tuples gives dual load exactly 1 on every one of the four three-letter types for all q>=3. Both objectives simplify to q(q+1)^2/4. The q=2 case has matching four-word integral primal and four-word dual certificates. The exact Fraction-based standalone verifier reconstructs all incidences for q=2..9. Infinite scope follows from symbolic type classification, not the tests. The strict integrality-gap corollary uses the published inequality s(4,3)>1/3.

value.rationale: A natural optimization relaxation for synchronization-error covering admits an exact all-alphabet value and matching symbolic rational certificates, and has asymptotic coefficient 1/4. Published integer-density bounds force a strict asymptotic integrality gap exceeding 4/3, a meaningful obstruction to improving integer covering results through the unstrengthened LP. The sharp binary exception is identified. This structural infinite-family separation is not a mere re-tabulation of known small integer covering codes.
